integrity: The infinite tail is proved from a published prime-interval theorem and parity of prime valuations; the only finite component is the exact range 12 through 49, replayed by the embedded verifier. The prime classification then follows by a complete two-case argument for primes at least 13 and explicit counterexamples for the five smaller primes.
scientific_limitations: Only the prime stratum of the obstruction set is classified. Composite squarefree parameters, density questions, and stronger quantitative lower bounds for the squarefree part of a factorial are not addressed. Nagura’s theorem is cited rather than reproved.
title: Prime stratum of the factorial six-factor obstruction set
